name: workspace_tree
description: Generate a clean, token-efficient directory tree of a workspace or folder. Automatically ignores noise directories (.git, node_modules, build, dist, vendor) and respects .gitignore. Supports max depth, extension filtering, file size reporting, and JSON or ASCII tree output.

path.description: Target directory path relative to workspace or absolute. Defaults to '.' (current directory).

max_depth.description: Maximum depth of directory traversal. Default 3.

show_hidden.description: Include hidden files/folders (starting with dot). Default false.

show_sizes.description: Include human-readable file sizes in the tree. Default false.

extensions.description: Optional list of file extensions to include (e.g. ['.go', '.kt', '.ts']). Other files are omitted.

ignore_patterns.description: Additional glob patterns or folder names to ignore.

format.description: Output format: 'tree' (ASCII/Unicode visual tree), 'json' (nested structure), or 'flat' (list of relative paths).

max_entries.description: Safety cap on total files and directories listed to avoid blowing context limits.
